role: Référentiel daté de O-20 (TF-1986) : où chaque image à état connue écrit ses données de travail, et les faits Docker qui font d'un volume la seule persistance. Donnée volatile (loi n° 4) : une image qui change de répertoire de données (postgres 18) se corrige ici, pas dans le code de l'oracle.

faits_docker.citation: Data written to the container layer doesn't persist when the container is destroyed.
A volume's contents exist outside the lifecycle of a given container.

faits_docker.fait: un volume anonyme est détruit avec --rm
faits_docker.citation: Just like named volumes, anonymous volumes persist even if you remove the container that uses them, except if you use the --rm flag when creating the container, in which case the anonymous volume associated with the container is destroyed.

faits_docker.fait: un montage tmpfs n'est pas persistant
faits_docker.citation: When the container stops, the tmpfs mount is removed, and files written there won't be persisted.

faits_docker.fait: syntaxe des deux options de montage
--rm retire le conteneur et ses volumes anonymes
faits_docker.citation: Automatically remove the container and its associated anonymous volumes when it exits
target: The path in the container where the volume is mounted.

images.citation: Mount the data volume at /var/lib/postgresql/data and not at /var/lib/postgresql. Mounts at the latter path WILL NOT PERSIST database data when the container is re-created.
The defined VOLUME was changed in 18 and above to /var/lib/postgresql. Mounts and volumes should be targeted at the updated location.
as /var/lib/mysql inside the container, where MySQL by default will write its data files.
mounts the /my/own/datadir directory from the underlying host system as /var/lib/mysql inside the container, where MariaDB by default will write its data files.
as /data/db inside the container, where MongoDB by default will write its data files.
If persistence is enabled, data is stored in the VOLUME /data
If you want to store results on a separate drive, map the /var/www/data folder to the location of your drive: docker run -p 3000:3000 -v /mnt/external_hd:/var/www/data opendronemap/nodeodm
